details.description: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct is a 7-billion-parameter vision-language model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released in January 2025 as the mid-size model in the Qwen2.5-VL family (3B, 7B, 32B, 72B). The Qwen team built it to read images, video and documents, generate structured outputs such as bounding boxes and JSON, and act as a visual agent for computer- and phone-use tasks, on top of a text chat model with a 128,000-token context window.
advantages: Scores 95.7 on the DocVQA document-understanding benchmark (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model card).
Scores 87.3 on the ChartQA chart-understanding benchmark (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model card).
Scores 58.6 on the MMMU multimodal reasoning benchmark (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model card).
Scores 68.2 on the MathVista testmini visual math-reasoning benchmark (Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model card).
Designed to comprehend videos over an hour long and pinpoint relevant segments with second-level timestamps (Qwen2.5-VL launch blog).
disadvantages: Catalog lists this deployment's modality as text input and text output only; the image and video understanding described on the model card may not be available through this route.
Alibaba has since released a newer Qwen3-VL vision-language series (models dated September-November 2025 on Hugging Face), and the Qwen2.5-VL GitHub repository has been renamed to Qwen3-VL.
use_cases: Extracting structured data such as invoices and forms into JSON output
Visual agent tasks such as computer- and phone-use automation
Long-video understanding and event localization in videos over an hour long
Object grounding by generating bounding boxes or points

notes: Catalog facts list this deployment's modality as text_input/text_output only (no image_input), and endpoints as /v1/chat/completions, even though Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct is natively a vision-language model and Fireworks' own host page for this model states it supports image input. Kept the catalog's text-only modality per instructions and flagged the mismatch as a disadvantage rather than describing vision as an available feature of this deployment. Context window: catalog and Fireworks host page both give 128,000 tokens, matching each other; the model's default config.json on Hugging Face is set to 32,768 tokens, which this write-up does not restate. github_url left null because the GitHub repository formerly named Qwen2.5-VL now displays as QwenLM/Qwen3-VL (a rename/redirect), so it no longer represents this specific model version; languages field left to just 'English' since that is the only language tag in the model card's metadata, though the model's OCR features are documented elsewhere as multilingual for text-in-image recognition.
